editionLabel: English HABA rules, 29-animal base game for two to four players
firstPlayerRule: The person who can balance on one foot like a flamingo for the longest time starts.
officialTieBreak: If the group cannot agree, the youngest player starts by rolling the die.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: This answer is for the 29-animal base game. HABA's smaller two-player Animal Upon Animal: Small and Yet Great! has a different opening instruction.

sources.title: Animal Upon Animal — HABA rules
